reviewKind: independent language and security implementation review
scope: audit output and relevant compile tests

findings.finding: The checker verifies references to the request and receipt types but does not verify their closed fields against the imported operation contract. Replacing ReminderMessage and ReminderReceipt with Text still passes jadpo check, allowing omission of the idempotency field and accepted_at receipt field.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate request/receipt field sets and types against the pinned operation schemas, with positive and negative compiler evidence.

findings.finding: The credential reference is checked only for configuration-field existence; it is not checked for a secret marker. Changing mail_api_key to secret: false still passes jadpo check.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require a typed secret configuration field and prove that secret material is restricted to the declared Authorization sink, with a compile-fail case for a non-secret binding.

findings.finding: The importer validates file availability and SHA-256 but does not parse the pinned OpenAPI snapshot or compare its operation and schemas against the source declaration, so supported-subset and broadening constraints are not enforced. Import resolution also walks source-path ancestors and can accept matching bytes from outside the project root.
findings.requiredCorrection: Parse the pinned snapshot and enforce the exact supported operation/schema subset, preserve a reviewable source-to-import diff, and constrain lookup to the owning project root. Add broadened-schema and outside-project import rejection cases.

reviewedWithoutFinding: Direct and transitive service-plus-write/atomic effect rejection paths have coverage.
The reviewer checked effect-context diagnostics, import lookup, audit output and related tests.
limits: Read-only implementation review. The reviewer did not edit files or run tests. RM-303 remains gated; the active RM-206/RM-106 implementation batch was not expanded by this review.
reviewGate: Resolve all three findings and obtain independent correction review before closing RM-302 or starting RM-303.
